newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN CALL AT 9.0 PCT IN LATE DEALS, LIGHT TRADE.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN CALL AT 9.0 PCT IN LATE DEALS, LIGHT TRADE.

text.p: Indian call money rose to 9.0 percent in trade just before the close on Wednesday on late demand from a few borrowers, dealers said.
Call money opened the day at 7.25-7.75 percent, down from Tuesday's close of 7.75-8.0 percent.

"It is only a few borrowers with small last-minute demand," said a public sector bank dealer. "I think they may have left some positions uncovered and as they have to report to the central bank tomorrow, they are borrowing in a panic."
He said most of the day's trade had been at 7.0-7.5 percent.
Banks normally report their fortnightly positions to the central bank on alternate Fridays. This fortnight they report on Thursday as banks are closed Friday for Independence Day.
